import json, random, sys, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
import ref, main

rng = random.Random(7)
for trial in range(300):
    n = rng.choice([0,1,2,3,5,8,15,30])
    fib=[]
    seen=set()
    while len(fib)<n:
        L=rng.choice([0,1,2,3,4,7,8,15,16,17,31,32,33,47,48,63,64,65,95,96,97,111,112,127,128])
        net=(rng.getrandbits(L)<<(128-L)) if L else 0
        if (net,L) in seen: continue
        seen.add((net,L)); fib.append((net,L,rng.randrange(65536)))
    nets=[f[0] for f in fib]; lens=[f[1] for f in fib]; hops=[f[2] for f in fib]
    order=sorted(range(n), key=lambda i:(nets[i],lens[i]))
    nets=[nets[i] for i in order]; lens=[lens[i] for i in order]; hops=[hops[i] for i in order]
    dh=None
    for i in range(n):
        if lens[i]==0: dh=hops[i]
    b=rng.randrange(0,120); e=rng.randrange(b+1,129)
    if e-b>40: continue
    cuts=[0,b,e,128] if e<128 else [0,b,128]
    if any(cuts[i+1]-cuts[i]<1 for i in range(len(cuts)-1)): continue
    st,used = main.compute_layout(nets,lens,hops,cuts,dh)
    # reference for each stage
    refs=[]
    for i in range(len(cuts)-1):
        refs.append(ref.spec_stage_cost(fib,cuts[i],cuts[i+1],root=(i==0)))
    if refs!=used:
        print("MISMATCH", trial, cuts, used, refs, [(ref.fmt(a)+'/%d'%l) for a,l,h in fib])
        break
else:
    print("U-table match OK")
PYEOF
